title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Terms: Reservations, Move-Out Notice, Vacate and Credit Balance Refunds
content:
**Reservations.** Reservations of a space under the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement are free and hold the space for the reservation hold of the class, in calendar days after the reservation date.

**Ending the agreement by notice.** Only the tenant can end a parking agreement by notice. The notice is recorded as received and moves the agreement to moving-out standing with a planned vacate date at least the move-out notice period of the class after the notice date. A delinquent tenant may also give notice; the unpaid balance stays owed.

**Rent at move-out.** Rent for a period starting before the planned vacate date is owed in full, and where the class does not credit unused days of the last paid period, no part of a period is refunded.

**Recording the vacate.** The vacate is recorded only for an agreement whose move-out notice is in received status, or for an agreement under a compliance termination notice whose vehicle is gone by the termination date. Fluid stains, debris or belongings left behind post the space clean-up fee of the class.

**Withdrawing a notice.** The tenant may withdraw a notice before the vacate is recorded. A withdrawn notice returns the agreement to active standing where nothing is past due, and to delinquent standing where past-due rent remains.

**Credit balance.** A credit balance is refunded within the refund period of the class after the vacate date, to the original payment method, or by mailed check when that method cannot be credited.

### Points of judgement

| Record | Vacate may be recorded? |
|---|---|
| Move-out notice in received status | Yes |
| Agreement under a compliance termination notice, vehicle gone by the termination date | Yes |

### Hypothetical illustrations

- A notice given on 20 August with a planned vacate date of 5 September, periods starting on the 1st: the period starting 1 September began before the vacate date and is owed in full; nothing of it is refunded where the class gives no proration.
- A vacate recorded on 5 September with a $12.40 credit balance and a refund period of 21 days: the refund is due by 26 September, to the original payment method or by mailed check where that method cannot be credited.
